modes.label: Acronym starts
modes.description: The first letters of an acronym or drug program name in parentheses or after 'called'.

modes.label: Bird names in lists
modes.description: The first modifier of a bird species name after 'and' or a comma in a list of species.

card.writes: It favors continuations that finish a rare name, such as Olymp, immel, stral, and ateg, and disfavors common endings like orne and oni.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a name or acronym has just begun and the rest of it is still to come.
